question: Which mantra sequence to the dark-limbed deity protects the pair of feet?
premises: The syllables klī, glauṃ, klīṃ are invoked.
Obeisance is offered to the dark-limbed one.
Protection is requested for the pair of feet.
inference: The sequence klī glauṃ klīṃ with obeisance to the dark-limbed deity protects the feet.
plain_english: May 'klī glauṃ klīṃ, obeisance to the dark-limbed one' protect the pair of feet.
